title: NashNash - 2 Units. 4BR. 5BA. Rooftop/Balconies!
description:
7 years Superhost on Airbnb brings you the perfect Nashville getaway in this charming 4-bedroom oasis!

* Price includes 2 units*

* Just 1 mile from Broadway
* Easy access ($7-10 Uber ride) to the best attractions and entertainment in Nashville - Downtown, The Gulch, Nissan Stadium, Bridgestone Arena, 12 South, Mid Town
* Rooftop
* New and modern unit including all amenities needed for your stay
* Gated Community
* 4 Reserved parking spaces inside the complex

Your urban adventure starts here!

The space
Units Description:

Unit A:

Lower level: Bedroom with 2 Queen beds and full bathroom
First Floor: Living room with Queen sofa bed and Half bathroom
Loft: 1 Full sofa bed
Second Floor Master Bedroom with 1 King bed and full bathroom
We also have 2 twin folding beds and an air mattress in the unit

Unit B:
First Floor: Living room with 2 Queen sofa beds and Half bathroom
Second Floor Master Bedroom with 1 King bed and full bathroom and  Bedroom with 2 Queen beds and full bathroom
We also have 2 twin folding beds and an air mattress in the unit
ROOFTOP with Nashville skyline

Guest access
* You'll have the entire house just for you and your guests. 
* We use a keypad locker for easy access

Other things to note
Uber Eats works really good in the area.
You might want to download the app and give it a try if you’re interested in food delivery to the unit
